load-pdf-extract-acroform-fields.title: Load PDF and List AcroForm Fields
load-pdf-extract-acroform-fields.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its AcroForm collection, and enumerate each form field displaying its hierarchical name and field type.

read-acroform-fields-from-pdf-stream.title: Read AcroForm Fields from PDF Stream
read-acroform-fields-from-pdf-stream.description: Shows how to open a PDF as a read‑only stream and use Aspose.Pdf to enumerate AcroForm fields without saving the file to disk.

retrieve-acroform-fields-from-pdf.title: Retrieve All AcroForm Fields from a PDF
retrieve-acroform-fields-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, checks for an AcroForm, and iterates through all form fields, outputting each field's name, type, value and read‑only status.

retrieve-pdf-form-field-value.title: Retrieve PDF Form Field by Name using Aspose.Pdf
retrieve-pdf-form-field-value.description: Shows how to load a PDF, access a form field by its name with the Document.Form indexer, and read its value using Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

list-form-fields-per-pdf-page.title: Iterate PDF Pages to List Form Fields
list-form-fields-per-pdf-page.description: Shows how to loop through each page of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate the form fields on that page, and output their names, types, and values.

enumerate-pdf-form-fields.title: Enumerate PDF Form Fields on a Specific Page
enumerate-pdf-form-fields.description: Loads a PDF document, checks for form fields, and logs each field’s name, type, and value for the specified page.

read-checkbox-value-to-boolean.title: Read Checkbox Value and Convert to Boolean
read-checkbox-value-to-boolean.description: Loads a PDF, retrieves a checkbox form field by name, reads its string Value ("On"/"Off") and converts it to a Boolean indicating whether the box is checked.

parse-number-fields-to-decimal.title: Sum Numeric TextBox Fields in PDF
parse-number-fields-to-decimal.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through form fields, parses numeric values from text box fields, calculates their sum, and writes the total back to a designated field.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON
export-pdf-form-data-to-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF document, retrieve its form fields, and export all form data to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-xml.title: Export PDF Form Fields to XML
export-pdf-form-fields-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF document, extracts its form fields, creates an XML representation with field names and values, and writes the XML to a file using a FileStream.

export-pdf-form-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON
export-pdf-form-to-fdf.description: Loads a PDF document, verifies the presence of form fields, and exports the form data to a JSON file using a FileStream.

export-acroform-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF AcroForm Fields to XFDF
export-acroform-to-xfdf.description: Loads a PDF document, checks for the presence of AcroForm fields, creates a FileStream, and exports the form fields to an XFDF file using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-to-html-png-xfdf.title: Export PDF to Multiple Formats with Aspose.Pdf
export-pdf-to-html-png-xfdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and export it to HTML, SVG, DOCX, and EPUB, closing each FileStream after the save operation.

modify-checkbox-appearance-extract-value.title: Modify Checkbox Appearance and Extract Its Value
modify-checkbox-appearance-extract-value.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, changing a checkbox field's border and background colors, setting its checked state, reading the resulting value, and saving the modified document with Aspose.PDF.

extract-pdf-form-field-values.title: Extract PDF Form Fields to Dictionary
extract-pdf-form-field-values.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its AcroForm, and retrieve all field names and values into a dictionary.

combine-pdf-form-data-into-json-array.title: Combine Form Data from Multiple PDFs into JSON
combine-pdf-form-data-into-json-array.description: Loads several PDF files, extracts all AcroForm field names and values using Aspose.Pdf, and writes the combined data as a JSON array for batch processing.

log-pdf-form-extraction-timestamps.title: Extract PDF Form Fields to CSV with Timestamp Logging
log-pdf-form-extraction-timestamps.description: Demonstrates how to read form fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, write them to a CSV file, and log the start and end timestamps of the extraction run.

serialize-pdf-form-data-to-json-bytes.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON Byte Array
serialize-pdf-form-data-to-json-bytes.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting AcroForm field names and values, serializing them to JSON, and returning the result as a byte array via a MemoryStream.

export-pdf-form-fields-with-prefix-to-js.title: Export PDF Form Fields with Specific Prefix to CSV
export-pdf-form-fields-with-prefix-to-js.description: Loads a PDF, filters form fields whose names start with a given prefix, extracts their values, and writes the results to a CSV file.

count-acroform-fields-in-pdf.title: Count AcroForm Fields in a PDF
count-acroform-fields-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, accesses the Form collection, and prints the total number of AcroForm fields present.

iterate-modify-pdf-form-fields.title: Iterate PDF Form Fields and Set Values
iterate-modify-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating over its Form collection, modifying text box and checkbox fields, and saving the updated document.

retrieve-pdf-form-field-types.title: Retrieve PDF Form Field Types
retrieve-pdf-form-field-types.description: Loads a PDF, checks for form fields, and prints each field's name together with its concrete Aspose.Pdf field class using GetType().

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML via MemoryStream
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF containing form fields, builds an XML representation of the form data, writes it to a MemoryStream, and prints the resulting XML.

export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON via FileStream
export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, open a FileStream, export the form fields to JSON using Aspose.Pdf, and rely on using blocks to automatically flush and close the stream.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to export a PDF's form and annotation data to an XFDF file by writing the output to a FileStream.

count-form-fields-on-each-pdf-page.title: Log Number of Form Fields per PDF Page
count-form-fields-on-each-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and log the count of form fields (widget annotations) found on each page.

extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.title: Extract PDF Pages as Individual SVG Files
extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through each page, and saves every page as a separate SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

combine-pdf-page-vector-graphics-into-sv.title: Extract Vector Graphics to Multi‑Page SVG
combine-pdf-page-vector-graphics-into-sv.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configuring SVG save options, and saving all pages as a single multi‑page SVG containing the vector graphics.

extract-subpaths-pdf-png.title: Extract Vector Subpaths as PNG Images
extract-subpaths-pdf-png.description: Demonstrates how to use GraphicsAbsorber to capture each vector subpath on PDF pages, render them on a temporary page, and export each as an individual PNG image.

export-pdf-page-as-png.title: Export PDF Page as Raster PNG Image
export-pdf-page-as-png.description: Shows how to render a specific PDF page to a PNG raster image at a given DPI using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-graphic-element-as-svg.title: Extract PDF Page as SVG
extract-graphic-element-as-svg.description: Loads a PDF document, extracts a specific page by its 1‑based index, and saves that single page as an SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-first-page-text-to-utf8-file.title: Extract First Page Text from PDF to UTF-8 File
extract-first-page-text-to-utf8-file.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract the text of the first page using TextAbsorber, and save it to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt.title: Extract Text from PDF and Save to TXT
extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all page text using TextAbsorber, and write the concatenated result to a .txt file.

extract-pdf-stamp-texts-to-json.title: Extract PDF Stamp Annotations to JSON
extract-pdf-stamp-texts-to-json.description: The example opens a PDF, iterates through each page to find StampAnnotation objects, collects their icon names, and writes the list to a JSON file.

extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf.title: Extract and Annotate Superscripts/Subscripts from PDF
extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to parse a PDF, identify superscript and subscript text based on font size and vertical position, and write the annotated result to a text file.

extract-paragraphs-with-line-breaks.title: Extract Paragraphs from PDF Preserving Line Breaks
extract-paragraphs-with-line-breaks.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract its text while keeping physical line breaks using TextAbsorber and TextExtractionOptions, and write the output to a .txt file.

extract-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's image resources, and save each embedded image as a PNG file in an output folder.

extract-fonts-from-pdf-ttf.title: Extract Embedded Fonts from PDF as TTF Files
extract-fonts-from-pdf-ttf.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates all embedded fonts, and saves each font's data to a .ttf file in a specified output folder.

extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Tables to Separate CSV Files
extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF, uses Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to detect tables, and writes each table to its own CSV file with proper field escaping.

export-acroform-fields-to-json.title: Extract AcroForm Fields to JSON
export-acroform-fields-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, reads its AcroForm fields, and writes the field names and values to a JSON file.

batch-extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.title: Extract Vector Graphics from PDFs to SVG Files
batch-extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files, extract each page as a separate vector graphic, and save them as SVG files using Aspose.Pdf.

parallel-pdf-text-extraction.title: Parallel PDF Text Extraction with Aspose.Pdf
parallel-pdf-text-extraction.description: Shows how to extract text from multiple PDF files concurrently using Parallel.ForEach and Aspose.Pdf's Document and TextAbsorber, storing results in a thread‑safe dictionary.

filter-export-large-graphics-pdf.title: Extract Large Images from PDF by Area
filter-export-large-graphics-pdf.description: The example opens a PDF, iterates through each page's image resources, calculates each image's bounding rectangle area, and saves only those images whose area exceeds a specified threshold.

extract-graphics-from-specific-pdf-pages.title: Extract Graphics from Specific PDF Pages
extract-graphics-from-specific-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's GraphicsAbsorber to extract graphic objects from selected pages of a PDF document.

combine-pdf-vectors-to-svg.title: Combine Multiple PDFs into a Single Multi‑Page SVG
combine-pdf-vectors-to-svg.description: Shows how to merge several PDF documents and export the combined result as one multi‑page SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-pages-to-svg-preserving-coord.title: Convert PDF to SVG Preserving Coordinate System
export-pdf-pages-to-svg-preserving-coord.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to convert a PDF file to SVG while keeping the original PDF coordinate system (origin at bottom‑left) intact.

pdf-summary-report-text-image-count.title: Generate PDF Summary Report with Text, Image, and Vector Counts
pdf-summary-report-text-image-count.description: The example opens each PDF in a folder, extracts the total character count, counts embedded images, and counts vector path objects, then prints a concise summary for each file.

extract-pdf-font-table-form-field-statis.title: Extract Font, Form Field, and Table Counts from PDF
extract-pdf-font-table-form-field-statis.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and log the number of fonts, AcroForm fields, and tagged tables found in each document.

validate-pdf-fonts-against-system.title: Validate PDF Fonts Against System Fonts
validate-pdf-fonts-against-system.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts the unique font names used on its pages, compares them with the fonts installed on the local machine, and reports any missing font dependencies.

extract-pdf-metadata-and-save-svg.title: Extract PDF Metadata and Convert Pages to SVG
extract-pdf-metadata-and-save-svg.description: The example opens a PDF, reads its title and author from the document information, and extracts each page as an SVG vector file.

extract-pdf-paragraphs-to-markdown.title: Extract PDF Text to Markdown with Indentation Preservation
extract-pdf-paragraphs-to-markdown.description: Shows how to load a PDF, extract positioned text fragments using Aspose.Pdf, calculate indentation, and write the content to a markdown file while keeping paragraph indentation.

export-pdf-tables-to-csv-with-borders.title: Export PDF Tables to CSV with Border Markers
export-pdf-tables-to-csv-with-borders.description: Demonstrates how to extract table text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, split it into rows and cells, and write a CSV file where each cell is wrapped with pipe symbols to visually indicate borders.

extract-checkbox-states-from-pdf.title: Extract Checkbox States from PDF AcroForm
extract-checkbox-states-from-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates through its AcroForm fields, gathers the checked state of each checkbox, and outputs the results as a JSON boolean array.

extract-svg-apply-brand-colors.title: Extract PDF Vector Graphics as SVG and Apply Brand Color
extract-svg-apply-brand-colors.description: The example loads a PDF, saves each page's vector graphics as separate SVG files, and replaces black fill and stroke colors with a specified brand color.

extract-vector-graphics-from-encrypted-p.title: Extract Vector Graphics from Encrypted PDF to SVG
extract-vector-graphics-from-encrypted-p.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF by supplying a password, extracting each page as a separate document, and saving the page's vector graphics as SVG files.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v2.title: Save JSON Form Data to UTF-8 File
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v2.description: Demonstrates writing a JSON string containing form data to a UTF‑8 encoded file using File.WriteAllText.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v3.title: Extract PDF Form Data to JSON Files
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v3.description: Loads each PDF in a folder, reads all form fields, and writes the collected values to a formatted JSON file with the same base name.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v4.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON or XML
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v4.description: Demonstrates how to read form fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write the collected name/value pairs to either a JSON or an XML file.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v5.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON via FileStream
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v5.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify it contains form fields, and export the form data directly to a JSON file using a FileStream with Aspose.Pdf.

extract-vector-graphics-to-svg__v2.title: Extract Vector Graphics from PDF Page to SVG
extract-vector-graphics-to-svg__v2.description: Loads a PDF, isolates a specific page, and saves its vector graphics as an SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf__.title: Extract Superscript and Subscript from PDF with Unicode Markers
extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf__.description: Demonstrates how to parse a PDF, detect smaller and vertically shifted text fragments, and wrap them with Unicode superscript or subscript markers.

extract-selected-radio-button-labels.title: Extract Selected Radio Button Values and Labels from PDF Form
extract-selected-radio-button-labels.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating over form fields, identifying radio button groups, and mapping the selected export value to its visible label.
